text:
## Key Principles  
| Principle | What It Means |
|---|---|
| **Lawfulness** | Data processing must be legal and justified |
| **Fairness** | Must be transparent with customers |
| **Purpose Limitation** | Only use data for stated purpose |
| **Data Minimization** | Only collect what's needed |
| **Accuracy** | Keep data current and correct |
| **Storage Limitation** | Only keep data as long as necessary |
| **Integrity & Confidentiality** | Protect data with security |
| **Accountability** | Document what you do with data |
name: Chunk 21/61

raw_entities.name: Lawfulness of Data Processing
raw_entities.description: A core compliance obligation requiring that all data processing activities must be legal and justified. This principle establishes the foundational requirement that processing must have a lawful basis before any other data protection principles apply.
context: Data processing must be legal and justified
Lawfulness | Data processing must be legal and justified

raw_entities.name: Fairness and Transparency with Customers
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation requiring staff to be transparent with customers regarding data processing. This principle mandates that customers must be informed about how their data is being used and processed.
context: Must be transparent with customers
Fairness | Must be transparent with customers

raw_entities.name: Purpose Limitation
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation restricting the use of collected data to only the stated and justified purposes. Staff must not repurpose customer data beyond what was originally disclosed and consented to.
context: Only use data for stated purpose
Purpose Limitation | Only use data for stated purpose

raw_entities.name: Data Minimization
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation requiring that only the minimum necessary data be collected to fulfill the stated purpose. This principle prevents excessive or unnecessary data collection.
context: Only collect what's needed
Data Minimization | Only collect what's needed

raw_entities.name: Data Accuracy
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation requiring staff to maintain customer data in a current and correct state. This principle establishes the duty to keep records up-to-date and rectify inaccuracies.
context: Keep data current and correct
Accuracy | Keep data current and correct

raw_entities.name: Storage Limitation
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation restricting the retention period for customer data to only as long as necessary for the stated purpose. This principle requires regular review and deletion of data no longer needed.
context: Only keep data as long as necessary
Storage Limitation | Only keep data as long as necessary

raw_entities.name: Data Integrity and Confidentiality
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation requiring staff to protect customer data through appropriate security measures. This principle mandates that data must be safeguarded against unauthorized access, loss, or damage.
context: Protect data with security
Integrity & Confidentiality | Protect data with security

raw_entities.name: Accountability for Data Processing
raw_entities.description: A compliance obligation requiring staff to document and demonstrate how customer data is processed and protected. This principle establishes the duty to maintain records and evidence of compliance with data protection principles.
context: Document what you do with data
Accountability | Document what you do with data
